description: This file defines classes related to data management within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including DataStore, DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser. It provides mechanisms for handling binary data, including reading, writing, searching, and memory alignment, with support for different endianness. The file also includes class relationships and utility functions for data manipulation.
external_methods: Note: memrcpy appears to be a typo or custom function, likely intended as memmove or similar.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a dynamically allocated buffer for binary data, providing methods for copying data, resizing, and accessing the buffer.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a binary data element with support for reading, writing, aligning, copying, searching, and handling endianness. It manages internal buffer references and cache updates.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Extends DataElement to support linked list of data segments, allowing for composite data structures and seamless traversal.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Provides a read-only, sequential access interface to a DataElement, supporting search, get, and set operations with internal offset management.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache references for DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the internal buffer to the specified type's alignment.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type and endianness from the data buffer.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Writes a number of specified type and endianness into the data buffer.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number pattern within the data buffer.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a segment of the data buffer into an external buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies external buffer data into the data buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the data element, possibly reallocating memory.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement into this one.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte pattern within the data buffer.
